name: [WINTER] FE2 Classic
desc:
📰 This game is a recreation of the 2017 - 2018 Flood Escape 2 era.
🎉 Miss when Corner Clipping still existed? It's back!
✅ Miss when Dark Sci-Facility was the "hardest" map? That stays true here!

🎁 Special events happen in this game every now and then. Join and participate in these events for special rewards!

Credits
⦁ Cam0Dev & Silent - Founders of FE2 Classic
⦁ luxTypes - Owns the game currently, made thumbnails & icon
⦁ Contrastual - Physics / Bugfixes
⦁ lunariitsu - Additional features / Bugfixes
⦁ Crazyblox - Original creator behind Flood Escape 2 & some of its music
⦁ Manel Navola & BSlick - Made most of Flood Escape 2’s music
⦁ Uncomfortable90zaza - Supplying the Familiar Ruins model

Support the original Flood Escape 2: https://www.roblox.com/games/738339342

For safety precautions or more information when playing, please visit: https://en.help.roblox.com/hc/en-us/articles/360031603131-General-Health-Notice
